title: Self-Instruct: Aligning Language Models with Self-Generated Instructions
authors_zh: Yizhong Wang, Yeganeh Kordi, Swaroop Mishra, Alisa Liu, Noah A. Smith, Daniel Khashabi, Hannaneh Hajishirzi
paper_type_zh: 合成指令数据生成与发布
best_for_zh: 适合构建自生成 instruction SFT 数据，或审计任务多样性与 teacher 错误的读者。
one_line: Self-Instruct repeatedly asks GPT-3 to invent, filter, and answer new tasks, expanding 175 human seeds into 82,439 synthetic SFT instances.
Self-Instruct 反复让 GPT-3 发明、过滤并回答新任务，把 175 条人写种子扩展为 82,439 条合成 SFT 实例。
why: It provides the canonical inspectable loop for bootstrapping instruction data while exposing the quality limits of self-generated targets.
inclusion_reason: Self-Instruct turns a small human seed set into a reusable pipeline for generating, filtering, and consuming synthetic instruction-target records.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Instruction-tuned models depend on human-written tasks and demonstrations, which are costly and often narrow. Self-Instruct asks whether a pretrained language model can expand a small human seed set into enough varied instruction-input-output records to improve its own instruction following without collecting a large new annotation campaign.

The paper answers with an iterative synthetic-data pipeline: prompt GPT-3 with accepted tasks to invent new instructions, remove malformed or lexically similar candidates, generate corresponding inputs and outputs, filter invalid instances, and fine-tune GPT-3 on the retained records. Starting from 175 human seed tasks, it produces 52,445 instructions and 82,439 instances. Primary source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2212.10560; venue: ACL 2023.

Instruction-tuned 模型依赖人写任务与示范，不仅成本高，覆盖也经常偏窄。Self-Instruct 想回答：预训练语言模型能否从少量人写种子出发，自行扩展出足够多样的“指令—输入—输出”记录，从而提升自身的指令跟随能力，而不必再组织大规模人工标注。

论文用迭代合成数据流程作答：以已接受任务提示 GPT-3 发明新指令，删除格式错误或词汇过于相似的候选，为剩余指令生成输入和输出，过滤无效实例，再用保留记录微调 GPT-3。从 175 条人写种子任务出发，最终得到 52,445 条指令和 82,439 条实例。官方来源：https://arxiv.org/abs/2212.10560；会议：ACL 2023。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
Self-Instruct makes the model both data author and training consumer: accepted human and machine tasks become in-context examples for generating the next instructions, while heuristic validity and similarity filters define which serialized instruction-input-output records enter SFT. Compared with human-only instruction tuning, the changed decision is to bootstrap the task distribution itself, not merely ask a teacher to answer a fixed prompt set.

Google Scholar citations: 3864（checked 2026-07-27；https://scholar.google.com/scholar_lookup?title=Self-Instruct%3A+Aligning+Language+Models+with+Self-Generated+Instructions&author=Yizhong+Wang&hl=en）

Open dataset: yes.

  • Name and location: Self-Instruct data, https://github.com/yizhongw/self-instruct/tree/main/data.
  • Scale: 175 seed tasks, 52,445 generated instructions, and 82,439 instruction instances.
  • Form and format: instruction records and instance records with instruction, optional input, and output fields, distributed in JSON/JSONL resources with generation and evaluation files.
  • Construction: iterative GPT-3 instruction generation, ROUGE-L similarity filtering, task-type classification, instance generation, and heuristic invalid-output filtering.
  • License and use: intended for instruction-tuning research; the checked README does not clearly establish dataset-level redistribution terms for every generated record, so verify the repository license and source terms before reuse.

Self-Instruct 让模型同时担任数据作者和训练消费者：已接受的人写与机器任务会成为生成下一批指令的 in-context 示例，而启发式有效性与相似度过滤决定哪些序列化的“指令—输入—输出”记录进入 SFT。相对只用人写数据的 instruction tuning，改变的决策是自举任务分布本身，而不只是让 teacher 回答固定 prompt 集。

  • 规模：175 条种子任务、52,445 条生成指令和 82,439 条指令实例。
  • 形式与格式：指令记录和实例记录包含 instruction、可选 input 与 output 字段，以 JSON/JSONL 资源连同生成和评测文件发布。
  • 构造方式：迭代式 GPT-3 指令生成、ROUGE-L 相似度过滤、任务类型判断、实例生成和启发式无效输出过滤。
  • 许可证与用途：预期用于 instruction-tuning 研究；已核验 README 没有清楚说明每条生成记录的数据集级再分发条款，复用前应检查仓库许可证与来源条件。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Seed the task pool. Input 175 human-written tasks, each with an instruction and example instances. These provide initial task forms and become in-context demonstrations for the generator.
  2. Generate new instructions. Sample eight accepted tasks into a prompt and ask GPT-3 to propose additional instructions. Output candidate task descriptions; later iterations mix machine-generated tasks back into the prompt so the pool expands beyond the seeds.
  3. Filter instructions. Remove malformed candidates and compute ROUGE-L similarity against every accepted instruction. Reject a candidate when its maximum similarity exceeds 0.7; otherwise add it to the task pool. This is a lexical diversity rule, not proof of semantic novelty.
  4. Generate and filter instances. Classify whether each instruction is a classification task. Generate input then output for general tasks, and use output-first generation for classification tasks to avoid collapsing to one label; remove repeated instructions, empty fields, and heuristic invalid outputs. Output instruction-input-output records.
  5. Train and evaluate. Fine-tune vanilla GPT-3 on the 82,439 retained instances and evaluate on SUPER-NATURALINSTRUCTIONS plus expert-written novel tasks. The student consumes one target output per instance; human audit, not a universal verifier, measures record validity.

1. 初始化任务池。 输入 175 条人写任务，每条包含 instruction 与示例实例；它们提供最初的任务形式，并成为生成器的 in-context 示范。
  2. 生成新指令。 从已接受任务中采样八条放入 prompt，让 GPT-3 提出更多 instruction，产出候选任务描述；后续轮次会把机器生成任务重新混入 prompt，使任务池扩展到种子之外。
  3. 过滤指令。 删除格式错误的候选，并计算它与全部已接受 instruction 的 ROUGE-L 相似度；最大相似度超过 0.7 就拒绝，否则加入任务池。该规则只约束词汇多样性，不能证明语义新颖。
  4. 生成并过滤实例。 先判断 instruction 是否属于分类任务；一般任务先生成 input 再生成 output，分类任务采用 output-first 以避免集中到一个标签。随后删除重复 instruction、空字段和启发式判定的无效输出，得到“指令—输入—输出”记录。
  5. 训练并评测。 用保留的 82,439 条实例微调 vanilla GPT-3，在 SUPER-NATURALINSTRUCTIONS 和专家编写的新任务上评测。student 每条实例消费一个 target output；记录有效性依赖人工抽检，而不是统一 verifier。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
1. Matched model improvement: vanilla GPT-3 scores 6.8 ROUGE-L on SUPER-NATURALINSTRUCTIONS, while the same model family fine-tuned on Self-Instruct data scores 39.9—an absolute gain of about 33 points and performance comparable to InstructGPT-001 in the paper's setup. The controlled difference is synthetic instruction SFT, although training/API details of the private InstructGPT baseline are not matched.
  2. Dataset-quality audit: human annotators judge only 54% of sampled generated items valid in every field. This does not negate the aggregate model gain, but it sets the data boundary: heuristic similarity and format filters leave substantial instruction, input, or output errors, so downstream reuse needs stronger record-level validation.

1. 同模型增益： vanilla GPT-3 在 SUPER-NATURALINSTRUCTIONS 上的 ROUGE-L 为 6.8，同一模型家族使用 Self-Instruct 数据微调后达到 39.9，绝对提高约 33 个点，并在论文设置下接近 InstructGPT-001。受控差异是合成指令 SFT，但私有 InstructGPT baseline 的训练数据与 API 细节并不匹配。
  2. 数据质量抽检： 人工标注者判断，抽样生成项中只有 54% 的所有字段都有效。这不否定整体模型增益，却明确了数据边界：启发式相似度与格式过滤仍留下大量 instruction、input 或 output 错误，因此下游复用需要更强的逐记录验证。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Earlier instruction tuning relies on a fixed set of human-authored tasks, even when model-generated answers are used. Self-Instruct changes the generated object to the instruction distribution itself: the model invents tasks, creates instances, filters them, and feeds accepted tasks back into the next generation prompt. The novelty is this closed synthetic-data bootstrap with explicit task and instance filters, not SFT or in-context prompting alone. It establishes the reusable lineage later expanded by instruction-evolution and response-generation pipelines.

以往的 instruction tuning 依赖固定的人写任务集，即使回答由模型生成，任务本身也不变。Self-Instruct 把生成对象改成 instruction 分布：模型发明任务、创建实例、执行过滤，再把接受的任务反馈给下一轮生成 prompt。新意是这条带明确任务与实例过滤的闭环合成数据自举，而不是 SFT 或 in-context prompting 本身。它建立了后来 instruction evolution 与回答生成流程继续扩展的可复用谱系。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• Teacher error amplification: the same model invents tasks and answers them, so factual errors and stylistic biases can reinforce themselves; only 54% of audited items have every field judged valid. Add independent answer checking and stratified human review before training.
  • Weak diversity guarantee: ROUGE-L below 0.7 removes close wording but not semantic duplicates, and the generator underproduces long-tail or unfamiliar tasks. Audit semantic clusters, task coverage, languages, and difficulty rather than trusting instruction count.
  • Artifact and transfer boundary: record-level source and redistribution terms are not fully clear, and results come from GPT-3-era models and benchmarks. Pin the repository revision, verify licenses, and rerun matched baselines on the intended modern model.

• Teacher 错误会放大： 同一个模型既发明任务又回答，事实错误与风格偏差可能自我强化；人工抽检中只有 54% 的记录所有字段都有效。训练前要加入独立答案检查和分层人工复核。
  • 多样性保证较弱： ROUGE-L 低于 0.7 只能排除近似措辞，无法排除语义重复；生成器也较少产出长尾或陌生任务。应审计语义聚类、任务覆盖、语言和难度，而不能只看 instruction 数量。
  • Artifact 与迁移边界： 逐记录来源和再分发条款并不完全清楚，结果也基于 GPT-3 时代的模型与 benchmark。复用时要固定仓库版本、核验许可证，并在目标现代模型上重跑匹配 baseline。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use Self-Instruct to bootstrap instruction SFT when human effort can supply a small, diverse seed set but not a full corpus. Generate candidate tasks, apply lexical and semantic deduplication, create task-aware instances, validate answers independently, and compare a model trained on accepted data with the same base model and a human-data baseline. The output is a versioned instruction-instance dataset plus rejection logs. Do not use the loop without stronger verification in high-stakes factual domains or where generated-data redistribution rights are unclear.

当人工只能提供少量多样种子、无法写完整语料时，可以用 Self-Instruct 自举 instruction SFT：生成候选任务，执行词汇与语义去重，创建与任务类型匹配的实例，独立验证答案，再让接受数据训练的模型与同一 base model 和人写数据 baseline 比较。产物是按版本管理的 instruction-instance 数据和拒绝日志。若高风险事实领域没有更强验证，或生成数据再分发权不清楚，就不应直接使用这条循环。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Object: an instruction, optional input, generated output, and filtering provenance used as one SFT instance.
  • Scale: 175 human seeds expand into 52,445 instructions and 82,439 instances.
  • Filter: maximum ROUGE-L above 0.7 rejects lexical near-duplicates but not semantic duplicates.
  • Evidence: SUPER-NATURALINSTRUCTIONS ROUGE-L rises from 6.8 to 39.9, while only 54% of audited records are valid in every field.
  • Reuse: add semantic diversity checks, independent answer verification, provenance, license review, and matched modern-model baselines.

• 对象：一条 instruction、可选 input、生成 output 和过滤 provenance，共同构成一条 SFT 实例。
  • 规模：175 条人写种子扩展为 52,445 条指令和 82,439 条实例。
  • 过滤：最大 ROUGE-L 超过 0.7 时拒绝词汇近似项，但无法排除语义重复。
  • 证据：SUPER-NATURALINSTRUCTIONS 的 ROUGE-L 从 6.8 升至 39.9，但人工抽检中仅 54% 的记录所有字段都有效。
  • 复用：补充语义多样性检查、独立答案验证、provenance、许可证审计和匹配的现代模型 baseline。
